description: This file defines a template class 'JsonRpcInterface' for handling JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets, including sending requests, handling responses and notifications, and managing asynchronous responses.

classes.name: JsonRpcInterface
classes.description: A template class providing an interface for JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets, including request sending, response handling, and notification processing.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and waits for the response, returning success status.

methods.name: setNotificationHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming notifications.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, dispatching to response or notification handlers.

methods.name: getAsyncResponse
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a response to a request with a timeout.

methods.name: createFutureResponse
methods.description: Creates a future object associated with a request ID for asynchronous response handling.

methods.name: removePromise
methods.description: Removes the promise associated with a request ID from internal storage.

methods.name: isRequestProcessingOngoing
methods.description: Checks if a request with a given ID is currently being processed.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming response messages, setting the promise value.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes a response string into a JsonRpc::Response object and extracts success status.
